content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to lock the cursor on the [product_name] display? I'd like the operator to be restricted to only viewing the display without the ability to navigate with the cursor. Is there a solution for this? Regards, [user_name]

No, that's not possible. You can restrict operating options by switching between administrator and operator modes. Returning to administrator mode requires a password. In operator mode, some menu items are inaccessible, and the operator cannot start or stop the [product_name]. They may only view certain data, such as IP information, but cannot modify it. See the attached [document].
Is it possible to remove specific menu items in the [product_name]? Regards, [user_name]
Please refer to my previous comment and the attached [document]. In operator mode, the operator cannot fully access the [product_name]; only the full menu is available in administrator mode.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking more granular control over the interface for [product_name], specifically the ability to restrict operators to a view-only mode without cursor navigation. The current user management system distinguishes between operator and administrator modes, providing limited menu restriction but not complete navigation locking. This falls short of user expectations for enhanced security and operational simplicity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to fully restrict cursor and navigation capabilities on the [product_name] display, allowing operators only to view information as part of a view-only mode.
